text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'd rather not.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
困ります。

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
Aww c'mon, why not?
You're single, right?
Come with me and we'll have lotsa fun together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいじゃん、
いいじゃん。
キミ、
一人なんでしょ？
俺と楽しいことしようぜぇ。

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
You know you want to.
Why else would you dress like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は誘ってるんだろ？
そんな格好してるんだからよ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: S-somebody, please help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰か～！　
助けて～！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
What's your problem, punk?
Take a hike.
What, you this chick's brother or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、お前？
邪魔すんじゃねぇよ。
てめぇ、この子の知り合いかなんかか？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: B-boyfriend?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
恋人っ！？

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
So I'm s'posed to lay off because she's your woman, huh?
Yeah, right.
Are you two really a couple?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分の彼女だから、
手ぇ出すなってか？
でも、怪しいな。
お前ら、
本当に恋人か？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Coup-what?!
Us, a couple? Of course n—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ！？
私たちが恋人なんて、
そんな──

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It'll be easier if he thinks that?
Oh, r-right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……そう思わせたほうがいい？
た、
たしかに……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
We're b... b... boyfriend and girlfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよ！
私たちは……
こ、
こ、
恋人なのよ！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text: You don't sound too convinced.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんかウソっぽいな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What do we do?
He doesn't believe us.
choice_data_list: Act like a couple would act.
Talk like a couple would talk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう……
信じてくれないわ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! But how are couples supposed to act?
I've never been in a relationship before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうね！
でも……
恋人らしいことって、
なにかしら？
私、
恋愛ってしたことないから……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Let me think, if this were a girls' manga...
What if you act manly and slam your hand on the wall?
{0}, lean in close and give the wall a good \"wham!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
少女漫画とかだと……
『壁ドン』とかかしら？
{0}君、
『壁ドン』して！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text: Ah! What the hell are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な！　
なんのつもりだ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Not to him! Do it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、その人でなくて、
私にするのよ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! But what do boyfriends and girlfriends usually
say to one another?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、そうね！
でも、
恋人同士って、
どんなことを言うのかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Let me think, if this were a girls' manga...
Maybe a l-love confession? You could tell me,
\"I really like you!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
少女漫画とかだと……
こ、
告白とか……？
「好きだ！」とかっ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I-it's never happened to me before, but I've always thought
love confessions were so romantic.
If you were to say that to me, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも、
私、
そんなこと言われたことないし……！
ずっとあこがれてるけど……
も、
もし、
{0}君に言われたら……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Couples confessing makes no sense? Oh, good point.
If we're already dating, then that would be doing things
backwards, wouldn't it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
恋人同士なのに、
告白はおかしい？
そ、そうよね！　
もう付き合ってるんだから、
順序が逆になっちゃうわよね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should we do?
This is trickier than I thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
どうすればいいのかしら……
難しいわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}!
Don't make me do all the thinking!
You try to come up with an idea, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら、{0}君！
私にばっかり考えさせてぇ……
{0}君も一緒に考えるの！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: If you had a girlfriend, what would you do with her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君は、
恋人とどんなことしたいの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You don't know?
*sigh* Clearly I need to educate you about more than just
academic subjects.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わからない？
う～ん、
{0}君には勉強だけじゃなくて、
もっと色々教えてあげないといけないわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Like girls' manga and romance novels.
I'll bring in a bunch of my favorites to our next class!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少女漫画のこととか、
恋愛小説のこととか……
今度いっぱい持ってきてあげるわね！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
Hey, damn it! You got some nerve ignoring me
and yammering on by yourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい！
オレを無視して、
何、二人っきりで盛り上がってるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. Once {0} and I start talking,
I have so much fun I lose track of what's going on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ごめんなさい。
{0}君とのおしゃべりが楽しくって、
つい……

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
Son of a...
Acting all lovey-dovey?
Guess they are a couple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそぉ……
イチャイチャしやがって！
マジで恋人だったのかよ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Whew, finally. Looks like he fell for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
よかった～
なんとか信じてもらえたみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sorry? Why are you apologizing?
For pretending to be my boyfriend?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なんで{0}君が謝るの？
恋人って言ったこと？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You've got nothing to be sorry for.
I was so happy when you stepped in to help me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君が謝る必要なんてないわ。
助けにきてくれて、
うれしかったんだから。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: And when you said you were my boyfriend...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
恋人って言ってくれたことも……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
N-nothing! I didn't say anything!
Yes, thanks again for getting me out of a bad situation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、ううん！　
なんでもないわ！
{0}君、助けてくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I owe you again.
I need to repay you somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また助けられちゃったし、
なにかお礼しないと。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there's a fancy-looking pastry shop right over there!
Let's go get something to eat.
My treat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
すぐそこに、
おいしいケーキ屋さんがあるの！
一緒に行きましょう！
ごちそうしてあげるから！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is more or less a real date now, right?
Hee hee. How exciting! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
これって……
なんだか、
デートみたいよね。
ふふふ、
楽しみ♪
